text:
maya: Heads-up — CS reported a p99 latency jump right after the 2026-02-20 canary rollout. Ticket CS-7842. p95 mostly fine, p99 went from ~850ms to ~4.7s.
jamal: Thanks, maya. Do we have the canary tag/version? Which runtime build rolled?
maya: rolled runtime v3.9.1-canary-a at 08:10 UTC. Canary traffic was 5% for ~30m before escalation.
kevin: I see the spike on Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/service/latency?panel=p99&from=08:00&to=09:30 — p99 jumps align with canary start. p95 ~stable.
sara: Do we have traces for affected requests? Any common path or model?
maya: Support attached trace sample: traceID=tr_0ab12cd. Mostly generation calls for chat endpoint using model: ggml-redwood-7b-q4_0.
leo: Could be kernel selector change in this runtime; v3.9.1 enabled a new batching heuristic and an experimental kernel switch for short sequences.
jamal: Quick triage plan: 1) confirm rollback reduces p99 2) bisect canary changes 3) collect flamegraphs & KV cache stats for slow traces. Who can run targeted rollback?
kevin: I can route canary traffic back to previous runtime (v3.9.0) and drop canary to 0% for affected shard. Doing that now.
ops-bot: action=route_update service=runtime shard=shard-17 from=canary(v3.9.1-canary-a) to=stable(v3.9.0) status=started
kevin: rolled back traffic for shard-17. Monitoring p99.
maya: Support confirms customer sees improvement in test repro after we pulled canary. Their p99 dropped near baseline within ~2m.
sara: Good signal. Next: bisect the canary build. List of changed components in v3.9.1-canary-a: batching heuristic, kernel-selector flag, quantization scheduling tweak, mempool allocator bump.
jamal: Start bisect: disable kernel-selector experiment first (most likely). We can flip flag at runtime for canary instances. Can someone push flag=false for kernel-selector on a small canary subset?
leo: Pushed kernel_selector=false on canary orderers for shard-17, left batching heuristic on. ops-bot: action=flag_update kernel_selector=false target=canary(shard-17) status=ok
ops-bot: metric_update panel=kv_cache_hit_rate shard=17 before=0.63 after=0.62
kevin: After kernel_selector=false, p99 improved ~30% but still above baseline (~2.8s). Not full fix.
sara: Next candidate: batching heuristic. Rolling batching config back to previous thresholds on canary nodes.
leo: Reverted batching_threshold to 8 from 12 on canary nodes. ops-bot: action=config_patch batching_threshold=8 target=canary(shard-17) status=ok
kevin: Observed p99 drop to 920ms after batching revert on shard-17. This is close to baseline.
maya: So combo of kernel-selector and batching changes caused tail latency. Likely interaction where kernel choice + larger batches cause head-of-line amplification for short sequences.
jamal: For mitigation: 1) keep canary at batching_threshold=8 and kernel_selector=false 2) hold full rollout until we patch kernel selector heuristics 3) add canary traffic cap to 2% and isolate shards with heavy short-seq load
kevin: I'll update rollout policy and create hotfix PR to adjust heuristic to prefer low-latency kernels for seq_len < 64.
ops-bot: action=rollout_pause scope=canary version=v3.9.1-canary-a reason=observed-p99-regression status=ok

sara: From an SRE perspective, add an alert to detect p99 deviance during rollouts: if p99 > baseline*3 for >3m then auto-pause.
jamal: Agreed. Also add synthetic golden-path tests during canary that run short-seq generation to catch this class of regressions.
maya: I'll update the support ticket with mitigation steps and timeline. Customer CS-7842 says they can validate next 24h.
kevin: Created PR #4523: kernel-selector heuristic patch; also added a canary gating test for short sequences.
leo: For postmortem: include reproducer (small script), flamegraph, and config diffs. Reproducer: ```bash
# repro short-seq tail
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
    -d '{"model":"ggml-redwood-7b-q4_0","prompt":"hi","max_tokens":32}' \
    https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate > /dev/null &
done; wait
```

sara: Good. Add how to check KV cache hit/miss and kernel selection logs:
```
redwoodctl metrics query "p99(latency) by shard" --from=08:00 --to=09:30
redwoodctl logs tail runtime --filter "traceID=tr_0ab12cd OR kernel_select" --since 10m
```

jamal: Final actions: kevin hold canary config (batching_threshold=8,kernel_selector=false), leo to patch heuristic, sara to add alerting + synthetic tests, maya to update CS ticket. We'll reconvene in 2h or sooner if regressions reappear. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all — please add short notes to the rollout runbook so next rollout has these checks.
kevin: noted. Posting links to artifacts: flamegraph: https://artifacts.redwood/p99-flame-2478901234.png pr: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4523

ops-bot: incident_note created id=INC-2026-091 latency-canary rollback+patch scheduled_by=kevin
maya: closing loop for now, will post final summary after PR lands and canary is green.
jamal: nice triage team.
kevin: ending watch on shard-17 but will monitor overnight.
